run_backtester_simple: run a simple train/test backtest on a time series using BackTesterSimple with ARIMA model
run_backtester_rolling_origin: run a rolling origin backtest with expanding training window using BackTesterRollingOrigin
run_backtester_fixed_window: run a fixed window ahead backtest with a gap between train and test data
run_cross_validation: run time series cross validation with multiple folds using the CrossValidation class
run_generic_backtester: run a generic backtest with a custom forecaster function using GenericBacktester
